title: [Master] - Slice 640775: [Sustainability] Reverse Sustainability part when reverse in GL Entries
summary: Reversing a G/L transaction now also reverses the sustainability ledger entries linked to it by transaction number, skipping entries already reversed. The reversing FA ledger entry gets a negated Total CO2e, so the fixed asset's Acquisition Total CO2e nets to zero.
key_points: Sustainability ledger entries are stamped with the G/L Transaction No. during General Journal and FA G/L Journal posting
Reverse Transaction on a G/L transaction reverses the linked sustainability entries through Sust. Entry Reverse Mgt.
Sustainability entries that were already reversed are skipped
The reversing FA ledger entry's Total CO2e is negated, so Acquisition Total CO2e nets to zero
OnCodeOnAfterStartOrContinuePosting now passes NextTransactionNo, and a new event OnInsertReverseEntryOnBeforeInsertFALedgEntry was added
quote: When a G/L transaction that included a sustainability part is reversed (Reverse Transaction), the sustainability part is now reversed too.
